controls.title: Architecture boundaries are explicit and match the code

findingTemplates.title: Not implemented: architecture boundaries are explicit and match the code

findingTemplates.title: Architecture boundaries unclear or leaking
findingTemplates.impact: Changes have unpredictable blast radius; security boundaries are hard to reason about.
findingTemplates.recommendation: Document inferred architecture and fix the leaking boundaries listed in evidence.

controls.title: No secrets committed to the repository

scoringRule.ABSENT: Live-format secrets found in tree or history.

scoringRule.IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED: No secrets seen in manual review; scanner not run.
scoringRule.IMPLEMENTED_STRONG: Scanner clean on working tree; history not scanned.
